$comment: Standing rules distilled from validation/corrections.json. HAND-CURATED, because deriving a rule from a free-text defect description is judgement and pretending otherwise would be the kind of false mechanism this repository exists to remove. What IS mechanical: every correction must be cited by a rule here or listed in `one_off`, and build-agent-briefing.py fails if any is missing. So the curation is visible and the coverage is enforced.
generated_note: Edit this file, then run: python3 validation/build-agent-briefing.py

rules.detail: Any claim naming a company, a number or a quote must be resolved to a file at the moment you write it. Never from memory, however certain — especially when it is a comparison against something you captured earlier in the same session. Confident, specific and wrong is the most damaging output this project can produce.
rules.cost: Three verbatim quotes attributed to companies whose captures do not contain them. Two reached the published board.

rules.rule: An empty result is a prompt to look, never a finding.
rules.detail: A selector returning nothing, a search returning zero, a 404 that renders with a title — none of these is evidence of absence. Sweep terms must be in the locale actually served, not the locale requested. State the search vocabulary and the locale beside every zero you report.
rules.cost: Nine results this round looked like data and were not, including an English term list run against a Spanish page that returned zero for every category and was nearly written up as an absence.

rules.rule: Every deferral carries a closing condition.
rules.detail: `not_observed`, `OWED`, `see capture file` — recording a gap honestly is not the same as closing it. A deferral must name what would close it and who owns it, or it becomes a floating note nobody returns to.
rules.cost: 222 open deferrals in one round, and 7 findings carrying a pointer where a confidence rating belongs.

rules.rule: No vocabulary without a written definition, before first use.
rules.detail: If you are assigning values from a controlled list, the list must have definitions and a decidable boundary test between confusable entries. A category used many times and defined zero times cannot be audited later.
rules.cost: A theme vocabulary used 121 times and never defined; a mandated confidence tri-state the data never held.

rules.rule: Verify the artefact, not the source.
rules.detail: Reading the generator is not checking the output. Build-time arithmetic is not a rendered page. If the deliverable is looked at, look at it.
rules.cost: Five cells truncated mid-sentence past a full read of 730 lines; a chart layer whose contrast check passed while every shaded cell rendered dark-on-dark.

rules.rule: Nobody clears their own check, and every checker gets attacked.
rules.detail: The author is the one party who cannot audit their own work. Before reporting that a check works, plant the defect it exists to catch and confirm it fires. A validator whose author has not tried to defeat it is not yet a validator.
rules.cost: Two checks declared working by their authors and both blind; one regex that matched only PascalCase and so never tested the prohibition it existed for. And C-052: I audited the board's five coverage ratios with a check that searched capture TITLES instead of file contents, got low numbers, and published the shortfall as a defect in the board. Three of the five derive exactly. The check was the broken thing, and I reported its result without attacking it first — two hours after writing this rule into every agent definition.

rules.rule: Do not generalise from the first instance you examined.
rules.detail: One directory, one file format, one vertical, one competitor. Check a second before stating a pattern, and say how many you checked.
rules.cost: A market-wide ranking claim measured on one vertical and overturned by enumerating a second; a roster counted as 17 independent companies when three share a parent.

rules.rule: An honest 'nothing found' is a valuable answer. A padded one is not.
rules.detail: If the evidence does not support the conclusion you were asked to reach, say so and name what would settle it. Never fill a table to look thorough, and never adopt a classification you marked unsure without review.
rules.cost: A registered palette that could not distinguish its own categories; an adapter that made its own exit condition unreachable.

rules.detail: A check that could not run must report as skipped, never fold into a pass. A missing input file is a skip, not a success.
rules.cost: A generated corpus silently short by four rows, all of them the round's own corrections.

rules.rule: A lesson recorded is not a lesson delivered.
rules.detail: Writing a correction down does not stop it recurring. Ask who would repeat this defect, and whether anything puts the record in front of them before they act. If the answer is a person remembering to mention it, that is not a mechanism.
rules.cost: Fifty corrections logged, and twelve of fourteen agents dispatched knowing none of them. The check that generates this block caught its own author leaving C-051 uncovered within a minute of being written.

one_off.$comment: Corrections whose lesson is specific rather than standing. Listed so coverage is complete and nothing is silently dropped.
